description: The pie chart in (a) illustrates the co-occurrence distribution of tokens with the word “reaction” in the chemistry domain, displaying six categories: “the” (31%, blue with diagonal stripes), “this” (21%, light blue with horizontal lines), “for” (17%, green with crosshatch), “chemical” (15%, light green with dots), “to” (9%, yellow with grid), and “in” (7%, light blue with vertical lines). The chart in (b) shows the corresponding distribution in the mathematics domain, with four categories: “the” (38%, blue with diagonal stripes), “$” (27%, pink with dots), “equilibrium” (19%, yellow with grid), and “constatant” (15%, gray with dots). Both charts use distinct patterns and colors to differentiate segments, with percentage values labeled directly on each slice, and the largest segment in each chart is visually emphasized by its size and position. The legend for each chart is placed above the respective pie, clearly mapping each pattern/color to its corresponding token.
